top10_contributor_plausibility_notes.MAPR-USD: FLAGGED, not fixed. Manual check of the raw and cleaned bars (data/research/eodhd/crypto/MAPR-USD.parquet) shows a per-unit price starting at ~$19,000 (2019-07) and later spiking as high as ~$1.6M with sparse, irregular trading gaps (e.g. consecutive KEPT bars 8 days apart) and a wildly erratic path even within one cleaning segment (2024: 1.26M -> 1.13M -> ... -> 1.6M -> 511K in adjacent kept bars). This is implausible as a genuine large-cap, liquid coin and did not trigger clean_bars' spike-reversal/segment-break rules only because the moves are gradual/choppy rather than single-day jumps. This is a concrete, realised instance of BIASES['wash_trading_volume'] in the FROZEN pre-registration (the $1M/day floor is necessary but not sufficient for genuine tradable liquidity) -- NOT patched here (out of this evaluation's mandate to implement the frozen design as declared), but its ~0.49 total-contribution figure should be treated as unreliable, not a real captured return.
